title: Scan workspace
description: Crop and adjust a retained document in the current three-pane AppKit workspace.

title: Print workspace
description: Letter paper, copies, colour, quality and explicit print-job controls.

title: Copy workflow
description: A synthetic retained copy at the ready-to-print stage; physical actions are disabled in fixture mode.

title: Device workspace
description: Connection, calibration guidance and recovery information beside the retained document.

title: Dark Mode
description: The same Scan workspace in a dark palette, keeping the document paper white.

title: Privacy & storage
description: The separate Settings window with diagnostic retention off and document-storage policy.
